failure_topology.detail: The reused header parser required MARKER TYPE to equal GEODETIC although the frozen plan did not declare marker type as an admission condition.
The complete-source receipt was appended only after structural admission. The ALGO source hash and byte count were computed in memory but were not retained when the undeclared header check raised.

scientific_attribution.reason: A descriptive/header-policy failure occurred before the declared physical clauses were evaluated.

frozen_consequences: DOY252 must not be retried or silently re-downloaded.
The generated JSON remains immutable evidence of the executed code path.
Future runners must retain the source receipt immediately after materialization, before descriptive or epistemic admission.
Future plans must not inherit an undeclared MARKER TYPE equality gate.
A future physical qualification requires a distinct predeclared artifact and a newly frozen implementation.
